final: SELECT COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing') as status, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) as distinct_sites, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref)) OVER () as share FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(s.insurstat, 'Missing') ORDER BY status
